subject: Migration 01 Step 1 — establish real Penpot migration workspace
body: Execute this as real Penpot work, not as a plan. First inspect the currently focused Penpot file/page and report its exact identity and current structure through tool evidence. Then create or prepare a clearly named editable migration workspace for the Westside Watch / 新西望 Figma migration, named 'Migration 01 — 新西望'. If the Penpot MCP, Penpot app, focused file, or rendering capability is unavailable, stop with the exact blocker and tool trace rather than claiming success.
